description: Portfolio gallery: oversized whitespace, two staggered SVG works, ochre accent, quiet captions.

referenceProfile.thesis: The work is the page: huge margins, a two-column staggered gallery, and captions set small so images carry all visual weight.
signatureMoves: The second work offsets vertically, breaking the grid just enough to feel curated.
A single ochre accent marks emphasis words and hover states.
transferPreserve: Keep imagery dominant, captions small, and whitespace generous around every work.
transferAvoid: Do not add cards, borders, badges, or multi-color UI chrome around the works.
